combos.strategyGuide.priority.avoid: You need request distribution across models.
combos.strategyGuide.priority.example: Primary coding model with cheaper backup for outages.
combos.strategyGuide.weighted.when: You need controlled traffic split across models.
combos.strategyGuide.weighted.avoid: You cannot maintain accurate weights over time.
combos.strategyGuide.round-robin.when: You want predictable and even distribution.
combos.strategyGuide.round-robin.avoid: Models differ too much in latency or cost.
combos.strategyGuide.round-robin.example: Same model on multiple accounts to spread throughput.
combos.strategyGuide.random.when: You want simple distribution with minimal setup.
combos.strategyGuide.least-used.when: You want adaptive balancing based on live demand.
combos.strategyGuide.least-used.avoid: Traffic is too low to benefit from usage balancing.
combos.strategyGuide.least-used.example: Mixed workloads where one model often gets overloaded.
combos.strategyGuide.cost-optimized.when: Cost reduction is your top priority.
combos.strategyGuide.cost-optimized.avoi: Pricing data is missing or outdated.
combos.strategyGuide.cost-optimized.exam: Background or batch jobs where lower cost is preferred.
combos.strategyGuide.reset-aware.when: You route across multiple accounts with quota telemetry and different reset windows.
combos.strategyGuide.reset-aware.avoid: Quota telemetry is unavailable for most accounts.

combos.strategyGuide.strict-random.avoid: Avoid when models have different quality or latency and order matters.
combos.strategyGuide.strict-random.examp: Example: Multiple accounts of the same model to distribute usage evenly.
combos.strategyGuide.p2c.when: Use when you want low-latency selection using Power-of-Two-Choices algorithm.

combos.strategyGuide.p2c.example: Example: High-throughput inference across 4+ equivalent model endpoints.

combos.strategyGuide.context-relay.examp: Example: Codex sessions that rotate across multiple accounts near quota exhaustion.

combos.strategyGuide.auto.avoid: Avoid when you need strict priority ordering or historical persistence.
combos.strategyGuide.auto.example: Example: Balance requests across models with different strengths.
combos.strategyGuide.lkgp.when: Use when you want to route based on historical success rates and performance.
combos.strategyGuide.lkgp.avoid: Avoid when historical data is limited or unreliable.
combos.strategyGuide.lkgp.example: Example: Route to models with a good track record on specific tasks.

combos.strategyGuide.context-optimized.e: Example: Distribute long conversations across models with larger context windows.
combos.advancedHelp.maxRetries: How many retries are attempted before failing a request.
combos.advancedHelp.retryDelay: Initial wait between retries. Higher values reduce burst pressure.
combos.advancedHelp.healthcheck: Skips unhealthy models/providers from routing decisions.
combos.advancedHelp.concurrencyPerModel: Max simultaneous requests allowed per model in round-robin.
combos.advancedHelp.queueTimeout: How long a request can wait in queue before timing out.
combos.advancedHelp.failoverBeforeRetry: When enabled, any upstream error triggers immediate failover to the next combo target, skipping all retries and fallback URLs.

combos.advancedHelp.setRetryDelayMs: Delay between set-level retry attempts, giving transient issues time to resolve.
combos.advancedHelp.disableSessionSticki: Rotate to a different connection on every request instead of pinning a whole conversation to one connection by the first-message hash. Overrides the global default. Leave on Inherit to preserve prompt-cache hits for multi-turn chats.

memory.concept.title: Conversational Memory
memory.concept.description: Orbit learns from every conversation, remembering facts, episodes, procedures, and semantic concepts that make responses more accurate and context-aware.
memory.concept.howWorksContent:
1. Automatic extraction: at the end of each response, facts and episodes are detected and saved automatically.
2. Retrieval: before each response, the most relevant memories are searched via FTS5 (exact), vector (semantic), or hybrid RRF.
3. Injection: relevant memories are injected into the assistant context to improve response quality.
4. Management: use this page to view, edit, export, and compact old memories.

settings.routingSettingsIntro: Controls how your requests are routed, transformed, and sent to AI providers.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphContainsD: Removes any paragraph (text block split on blank lines) inside the system prompt whose text contains ANY of the listed substrings. Use to strip third-party client fingerprints like 'github.com/anomalyco/opencode' or 'docs.openwebui.com' that Anthropic's classifier flags.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphStartsWit: Removes any paragraph that STARTS WITH one of the listed prefixes. Use for identity lines like 'You are OpenCode' or 'You are Open WebUI' that announce the calling client.
settings.routingOpReplaceTextDesc: Replaces a literal substring with another literal substring. Use for known trigger phrases — e.g. rewrite 'Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:' to 'Environment context you are running in:' (an empirically-validated trigger phrase).
settings.routingOpReplaceRegexDesc: Replaces text matching a regular expression. Use when you need patterns (character classes, optional whitespace, anchors) instead of literal substrings. A malformed pattern is caught at runtime when the op runs.
settings.routingOpDropBlockContainsDesc: Removes ENTIRE system blocks (not just paragraphs) whose text contains any of the listed substrings. Use when a whole block is fingerprint-bearing and you want it gone — e.g. an injected MCP-server description.
settings.routingOpPrependSystemBlockDesc: Inserts a new text block at the FRONT of the system array. Use to add the SDK identity 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' that Anthropic's classifier expects.
settings.routingOpAppendSystemBlockDesc: Inserts a new text block at the END of the system array. Use for cosmetic additions that don't need to be at position [0].
settings.routingOpInjectBillingHeaderDes: Prepends the special 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=...; cch=...;' text block that Anthropic's classifier validates. Required for CC bridge relay endpoints; for the native claude provider Orbit already injects its own billing line so this op is usually redundant there.
settings.routingOpObfuscateWordsDesc: Inserts a Zero-Width-Joiner character after the first letter of each listed word, so 'opencode' becomes 'o‍pencode'. Reads identical to humans but bypasses classifier word matches. Targets system blocks, user/assistant messages, and tool descriptions.
settings.routingNeedlesHint: List of substrings. A paragraph matches if it contains ANY one of them. Add one per line via 'Add entry'.
settings.routingPrefixesHint: List of strings. A paragraph matches if it starts with any one of them (leading whitespace is trimmed before matching).
settings.routingCaseSensitiveHint: When ON, 'OpenCode' and 'opencode' are different strings. When OFF (default), the comparison ignores case.
settings.routingMatchLiteralHint: Exact literal substring to find. No regex syntax — special chars like . * ? are treated as themselves.
settings.routingReplacementTextHint: Replacement string. Leave blank to delete the match. The output preserves surrounding text.
settings.routingAllOccurrencesHint: When ON (default), every instance is replaced. When OFF, only the first match is replaced.
settings.routingPatternHint: JavaScript regex source. Don't wrap in slashes — just 'foo(.*)bar'. Server rejects patterns that fail to compile.
settings.routingRegexFlagsHint: JavaScript regex flags (g = all matches, i = case-insensitive, s = dot matches newline, m = multiline). Default 'g'.
settings.routingBlockTextHint: Full text of the new system block. Use a literal string; the system block stores text only.
settings.routingIdempotencyKeyHint: Optional. If set, the op skips when a block whose text starts with this key is already present. Prevents double-prepend on retries.
settings.routingBillingEntrypointHint: Value injected as 'cc_entrypoint='. Anthropic accepts 'sdk-cli' (Agent SDK), 'cli' (Claude Code CLI), or other documented values.
settings.routingBillingVersionFormatHint: How the 3-char build hash after cc_version= is computed. 'ex-machina' = sha256 of CCH_SALT+chars-from-first-user-msg+version (per-message). 'orbit-daystamp' = sha256 of YYYY-MM-DD+version (stable per-day).
settings.routingBillingCchAlgoHint: How the 5-char cch= token is computed. 'sha256-first-user' = sha256 of first user message text. 'xxhash64-body' = body-level signing fills it later. 'static-zero' = literal '00000' placeholder.
settings.routingObfuscateWordsHint: Lowercase words to obfuscate. ZWJ insertion is applied case-insensitively, so 'opencode' also matches 'OpenCode' and 'OPENCODE'.
settings.routingObfuscateTargetsHint: Which body regions to scan for the words: system blocks, user/assistant messages, and/or tool descriptions.

omniglyph.enableDescription: Runs last in the stack after text engines clean the request, using the native provider wire; OpenAI Chat/Responses requests are compressed after translation so their shape is preserved. It also runs standalone through omniglyph mode. This is a preview and remains off by default until end-to-end validation is complete.
omniglyph.profileDescription: The profile is a ceiling, not a floor: a stricter profile cannot be reopened by a per-step override. Measured on this codebase: with coding-safe or balanced, a session that has not accumulated history yet compresses nothing, because both raise the minimum-characters threshold and keep the system prompt, tool schemas and tool results native.

legal.privacySection1Text: Orbit is designed as a local-first application. All data processing and storage occurs entirely on your machine. There is no centralized server collecting your information.
legal.privacyDataStoredIn: The following data is stored locally in
legal.privacyDataProviderConfigurationsD: connection URLs, provider types, and priority settings

legal.privacyDataUsageLogsDesc: request counts, token usage, model names, timestamps, and response times

legal.privacySection3Text: Orbit does not collect telemetry, analytics, or crash reports. No data is sent to us or any third party. Your usage patterns, API calls, and configurations remain entirely private.
legal.privacySection4Text: When you make API calls through Orbit, your requests are forwarded to the AI providers you have configured (for example: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). These providers have their own privacy policies that govern how they handle your data. Please review:
legal.privacySection5Text: If you enable the optional cloud sync feature, provider configurations and API keys may be transmitted to a configured cloud endpoint. This feature is disabled by default and requires explicit opt-in.
legal.privacyLoggingIntro: Request logs can be configured through the dashboard settings. You can:
legal.privacySection7TextStart: Since all data is stored locally, you have full control. You can delete your data at any time by removing the
legal.privacySection7TextEnd: directory or using the database backup and restore features in the dashboard.
legal.termsSection1Text: Orbit is a local-first AI API proxy router that operates entirely on your machine. It routes requests to multiple AI providers with load balancing, failover, and usage tracking.
legal.termsResponsibilityApiKeys: You are solely responsible for managing your own API keys and credentials for third-party AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.).
legal.termsResponsibilityCompliance: You must comply with the terms of service of each AI provider whose API you access through Orbit.
legal.termsResponsibilitySecurity: You are responsible for the security of your local Orbit installation, including setting a password and restricting network access.
legal.termsSection3Text: Orbit acts as an intermediary proxy. API calls sent to Orbit are translated and forwarded to your configured AI providers. Orbit does not modify the content of your requests or responses beyond the necessary protocol translation.
legal.termsDataStoredLocally: All data is stored locally on your machine in a SQLite database.
legal.termsNoTransmission: Orbit does not transmit any data to external servers unless you explicitly enable cloud sync features.

legal.termsSection5Text: Orbit is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not responsible for any costs incurred through API usage, service disruptions, or data loss. Always maintain backups of your configuration.
legal.termsSection6Text: Orbit is open-source software. You are free to inspect, modify, and distribute it under the terms of its license.

agentSkills.catalog.omni-auth.name: Authentication
agentSkills.catalog.omni-auth.descriptio: Manage API key authentication and session tokens. Start here to authenticate requests via Bearer token, obtain session cookies, and configure login requirements for the Orbit API.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-providers.name: Providers
agentSkills.catalog.omni-providers.descr: Manage provider connections, API keys, OAuth flows, and connection tests via the REST API. List, add, update, remove, and test AI provider integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and 160+).
agentSkills.catalog.omni-models.name: Models
agentSkills.catalog.omni-models.descript: Query available AI models across all configured providers. List models, resolve model aliases, and browse the full model catalog including provider-specific variants.
Create and manage routing combos with 14 strategies (priority, weighted, round-robin, Auto-combo, etc.). Configure fallback chains, test routing outcomes, and retrieve combo metrics.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-api-keys.name: API Keys
agentSkills.catalog.omni-api-keys.descri: Create, list, rotate, and revoke Orbit API keys. Control per-key scopes, spending limits, and expiration. Keys gate access to all proxy and management endpoints.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-usage-logs.name: Usage & Logs
agentSkills.catalog.omni-usage-logs.desc: Access detailed call logs and usage analytics. Filter by provider, model, time range, status, and cost. Export logs and aggregate token usage across all connections.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-budget.name: Budget & Rate Limits
agentSkills.catalog.omni-budget.descript: Configure spending limits, token quotas, and rate-limit policies per API key or globally. Inspect current consumption and enforce cost controls across providers.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-settings.name: Settings
agentSkills.catalog.omni-settings.descri: Read and update global application settings: system prompts, thinking budget, IP filters, payload rules, combo defaults, and require-login configuration.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-proxies.name: Proxy Configuration
agentSkills.catalog.omni-proxies.descrip: Configure HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxies for upstream provider requests. Set per-provider or global proxy rules, test connectivity, and manage proxy rotation.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-cache.name: Cache
agentSkills.catalog.omni-cache.descripti: Manage the LLM response cache. View cache statistics, clear entries, configure TTL policies, and control semantic-similarity caching thresholds.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-compression.des: Configure RTK (command output), Caveman (prose), and stacked compression modes. Manage language packs, custom rules, and test prompt compression reducing tokens by 60–90%.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-context-rtk.des: Configure RTK filters, context engineering rules, and context relay settings. Test compression with real prompt samples and manage context transformation pipelines.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-resilience.name: Resilience & Monitoring
agentSkills.catalog.omni-resilience.desc: Monitor provider health, circuit-breaker states, p50/p95/p99 latency metrics, and budget guard alerts. Inspect connection cooldowns and model lockouts in real time.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-cli-tools.name: CLI Tools
agentSkills.catalog.omni-cli-tools.descr: Manage CLI tool integrations exposed via the API. List, configure, and invoke CLI tool plugins that extend Orbit's automation surface.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-tunnels.name: Tunnels
agentSkills.catalog.omni-tunnels.descrip: Create and manage secure tunnels (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, custom) to expose Orbit to the internet or share access with remote agents and CI pipelines.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-sync-cloud.name: Cloud Sync
agentSkills.catalog.omni-sync-cloud.desc: Synchronise Orbit configuration, provider connections, and settings to/from cloud storage. Manage cloud worker authentication and remote backup targets.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-db-backups.name: Database & Backups
agentSkills.catalog.omni-db-backups.desc: Trigger system backups, restore from backup files, and manage the SQLite database lifecycle. Supports export, import, and incremental snapshot strategies.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-webhooks.name: Webhooks
agentSkills.catalog.omni-webhooks.descri: Register, list, test, and remove webhook endpoints. Configure event subscriptions (request.completed, request.failed, quota.exceeded, etc.) and manage delivery retries.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-mcp.name: MCP Server
agentSkills.catalog.omni-mcp.description: Connect to the Orbit MCP server (37 tools, 3 transports: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Covers routing, cache, compression, memory, skills, providers, and audit tools across 16 permission scopes.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-agents-a2a.name: Agents & A2A Protocol
agentSkills.catalog.omni-agents-a2a.desc: Interact with Orbit via JSON-RPC 2.0 agent-to-agent protocol. 6 built-in A2A skills: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report, list-capabilities.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-version-manager: Install, start, stop, restart, and update embedded services (9Router, CLIProxyAPI). Monitor service status, retrieve logs, and configure auto-start for local-only service endpoints.
agentSkills.catalog.omni-inference.name: Inference (OpenAI-compatible)
agentSkills.catalog.omni-inference.descr: The core OpenAI-compatible inference endpoints: chat completions, embeddings, images, audio (TTS/STT), moderations, rerank, and the Responses API. The primary integration surface for AI agents.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-serve.name: CLI: Serve
agentSkills.catalog.cli-serve.descriptio: Start, stop, and restart the Orbit server from the CLI. Manage daemon mode, port configuration, auto-recovery, system tray integration, and the dashboard open shortcut.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-health.name: CLI: Health
agentSkills.catalog.cli-health.descripti: Check server health, component status, and live metrics from the CLI. Run `health`, `health components`, and `health watch` for a real-time dashboard of circuit breakers and provider status.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-providers.name: CLI: Providers
agentSkills.catalog.cli-providers.descri: Manage provider connections from the CLI: list available/configured providers, add, test, test-all, validate, rotate API keys, and view per-provider metrics.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-keys.name: CLI: API Keys
agentSkills.catalog.cli-keys.description: Create, list, rotate, and revoke Orbit API keys from the CLI. Manage OAuth flows for provider authentication and inspect key scopes and expiration.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-models.name: CLI: Models
agentSkills.catalog.cli-models.descripti: Query available AI models, list model aliases, and browse the full model catalog from the CLI. Filter by provider, search by capability, and resolve model name variants.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-chat.name: CLI: Chat
agentSkills.catalog.cli-chat.description: Send chat completions, stream responses, and start an interactive REPL session from the CLI. Supports all Orbit providers, combo routing, and system prompt configuration.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-routing.name: CLI: Routing & Combos
agentSkills.catalog.cli-routing.descript: Create, list, update, and delete routing combos from the CLI. Test routing strategies, inspect combo metrics, and configure fallback chains interactively.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-resilience.name: CLI: Resilience & Quotas
agentSkills.catalog.cli-resilience.descr: Inspect and manage circuit-breaker states, connection cooldowns, quota limits, and backoff levels from the CLI. Reset stuck providers and configure resilience thresholds.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-compression.name: CLI: Compression
agentSkills.catalog.cli-compression.desc: Configure and test prompt compression from the CLI. Manage RTK filters, Caveman rules, stacked compression modes, and preview compression output with real prompts.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-contexts.name: CLI: Contexts & Sessions
agentSkills.catalog.cli-contexts.descrip: Manage context engineering configurations, RTK filter sets, and conversation sessions from the CLI. Apply context-relay settings and inspect active context pipelines.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-cost-usage.name: CLI: Cost & Usage
agentSkills.catalog.cli-cost-usage.descr: View cost breakdowns, token usage, and call logs from the CLI. Filter by provider, model, or date range. Export usage reports and inspect per-connection spending.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-mcp.name: CLI: MCP
agentSkills.catalog.cli-mcp.description: Inspect the MCP server status, list registered tools and scopes, run tool invocations, and manage MCP audit logs from the CLI.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-a2a.name: CLI: A2A Protocol
agentSkills.catalog.cli-a2a.description: Interact with the Orbit A2A server from the CLI. Send tasks, inspect skill execution history, and test the JSON-RPC 2.0 agent-to-agent protocol interactively.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-tunnel.name: CLI: Tunnels
agentSkills.catalog.cli-tunnel.descripti: Start and stop tunnel connections (ngrok, Cloudflare, custom) from the CLI. Inspect active tunnel URLs, configure authentication, and test external reachability.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-backup-sync.name: CLI: Backup & Sync
agentSkills.catalog.cli-backup-sync.desc: Backup and restore Orbit data from the CLI. Trigger incremental snapshots, sync to cloud storage, manage backup schedules, and restore from archive files.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-policy-audit.des: Inspect audit logs, manage access policies, view telemetry data, and review request history from the CLI. Filter by event type, user, or time range for compliance workflows.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-batches.name: CLI: Batches & Files
agentSkills.catalog.cli-batches.descript: Submit and monitor batch inference jobs from the CLI. Upload and manage files for batch processing, retrieve results, and integrate batch pipelines with CI/CD workflows.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-eval.name: CLI: Evals
agentSkills.catalog.cli-eval.description: Create and run evaluation suites, watch live benchmark progress, view scorecards, compare model performance, and integrate eval runs with CI workflows from the CLI.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-plugins-skills.d: Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.
agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.name: CLI: Setup & Config
agentSkills.catalog.cli-setup.descriptio: Run initial setup, configure global CLI settings, manage environment variables, check for updates, and configure autostart via the CLI setup and config commands.
Detect installed CLI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline and more), search GitHub for matching agent skills, and install them to the detected tools via Orbit's built-in APIs.

featureFlags.restartRequiredDescription: These flags only apply after the process reloads. Restart now or continue editing — pending flags stay queued until you confirm.
featureFlags.restartViewDescription: These flags only take effect after the server restarts. Toggle them like any other flag — the change is persisted immediately, but the new value is only read at process startup. Use the Restart Server banner above to apply.
featureFlags.definitions.REQUIRE_API_KEY: Require an API key for all incoming requests.
featureFlags.definitions.INPUT_SANITIZER: Enable input sanitization for all requests.
featureFlags.definitions.PII_REDACTION_E: Redact personally identifiable information from requests.
featureFlags.definitions.PII_RESPONSE_SA: Sanitize personally identifiable information in provider responses.
Choose how response PII is handled: redact replaces it, warn only logs it, block rejects the response, and off disables sanitization.
featureFlags.definitions.OUTBOUND_SSRF_G: Block outbound requests to private or internal IP ranges.
featureFlags.definitions.ALLOW_API_KEY_R: Allow authenticated dashboard users to reveal stored API keys instead of seeing masked values only.
featureFlags.definitions.PROXY_AUTO_SELE: When no proxy is assigned to a connection, automatically select the first working registry proxy. Off by default because otherwise one registry proxy becomes a global fallback for all traffic (#3332).
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_CONTROL_P: Allow OAuth and provider-validation flows to bypass a pinned proxy when proxy reachability checks fail. Off by default because this can change the account egress IP.
featureFlags.definitions.MITM_DISABLE_TL: Disable TLS certificate verification for the MITM proxy.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_ALLOW_PRI: Allow provider URLs that point to private or internal networks.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_ALLOW_LOC: Allow providers on localhost, LAN, and private IP ranges. This is required for local OpenAI-compatible models and enabled by default. Cloud-metadata endpoints such as 169.254.169.254 remain blocked.
featureFlags.definitions.TOOL_POLICY_MOD: Set the tool-use policy enforcement mode.
featureFlags.definitions.RATE_LIMIT_AUTO: Automatically enable rate limiting based on usage patterns.
featureFlags.definitions.ALLOW_MULTI_CON: Allow multiple connections for each compatibility node.
featureFlags.definitions.DISABLE_CONTEXT: Skip Orbit's local context-window and max-input-token check for direct single-model requests. Upstream providers still enforce their actual limits. Prompt compression and output-token caps remain active.
featureFlags.definitions.RESPONSES_PASST: Remove internal commentary-phase output items from Responses API passthrough streams before forwarding them to clients. Disable this flag to receive raw upstream commentary.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_MCP_ENFOR: Enforce scope restrictions for MCP tool access.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_MCP_COMPR: Compress MCP tool descriptions to reduce token usage.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_DISABLE_B: Disable all background services, including quota refresh and synchronization.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_RTK_TRUST: Trust project-level RTK filters without validation.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_ENABLE_LI: Enable the realtime app's dashboard WebSocket server on port 20132. Set the flag to 0 or false to disable it. LAN exposure also requires LIVE_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 and LIVE_WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_CODEX_WS_: Allow Codex to use Responses over WebSocket. When disabled, Codex falls back to HTTP Responses.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_EMERGENCY: Route budget-exhausted requests to the emergency free fallback provider and model.
featureFlags.definitions.STREAM_RECOVERY: Retry truncated upstream SSE streams transparently before any response bytes reach the client.
Allow stream recovery to request the response again and stitch it after bytes have already reached the client.
featureFlags.definitions.MODEL_CATALOG_I: Include display-friendly name fields in /v1/models responses. Disable this for clients that accept model IDs only.
featureFlags.definitions.MODELS_CATALOG_: Control model-ID prefixes in /v1/models: dual emits alias and canonical prefixes, alias emits short prefixes only, and canonical emits full provider IDs only.
featureFlags.definitions.ARENA_ELO_SYNC_: Periodically synchronize Arena AI leaderboard ELO data for model-intelligence rankings.
Enable compatibility mode for all CLI clients.
featureFlags.definitions.PRICING_SYNC_EN: Synchronize pricing data automatically. The PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED environment variable must also be true.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_AUTO_SYNC: After provider-model synchronization, regenerate ~/.codex/*.config.toml profiles from the live catalog. This never changes the active or default Codex configuration and is off by default.

After provider-model synchronization, regenerate ~/.claude/profiles/<name>/settings.json profiles from the live catalog. This never changes the active or default Claude configuration and is off by default.
featureFlags.definitions.ORBIT_DISABLE_L: Disable the local instance health-check endpoint.
featureFlags.definitions.SKILLS_SANDBOX_: Enable network access in the skills sandbox.

publicSystem.statusPages.429.suggestion3: Tune provider resilience/rate-limit profiles in settings.
publicSystem.statusPages.500.title: Internal Server Error

publicSystem.statusPages.500.suggestion2: Check health telemetry and server logs for correlated request IDs.
publicSystem.statusPages.500.suggestion3: If persistent, report the issue with timestamp and request context.

publicSystem.statusPages.502.suggestion1: Retry with another provider or active combo route.
publicSystem.statusPages.502.suggestion2: Check provider credentials and model availability.
publicSystem.statusPages.502.suggestion3: Inspect translator output if format conversion is involved.
publicSystem.statusPages.503.title: Service Unavailable
publicSystem.statusPages.503.description: The service is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance or degraded dependencies.
publicSystem.statusPages.503.suggestion2: Check maintenance notices and system status.
publicSystem.statusPages.503.suggestion3: Use fallback providers if your workflow is latency-sensitive.
